entities.name: Burke
entities.description: A shapeless, gel-bodied nightmare-horror created by Chainer with the Mirari to serve Laquatus.

entities.name: Laquatus
entities.description: Merman ambassador whom Burke served as bodyguard.

entities.name: Chainer
entities.description: Creator of Burke using the Mirari.

entities.name: Turg
entities.description: Laquatus's earlier servant, whose death led to Burke's creation.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: Powerful artifact used to create Burke and sought by Laquatus.

entities.name: Empress Llawan
entities.description: Ruler Laquatus fought in a war.

entities.name: Veza
entities.description: Escaped from Laquatus's vessel; Burke broke her ankle chasing her.

entities.name: Balthor
entities.description: Dwarf who destroyed Burke with a suicide fire spell.

entities.name: Kamahl
entities.description: Fled with Balthor to Krosa, chased by Burke.

entities.name: Battle for the Mirari
entities.description: Battle during which Burke was created.

events.summary: Burke is created during the Battle for the Mirari and obeys Laquatus's every command.
events.quote: Burke was created during the Battle for the Mirari and obeyed Laquatus's every command

events.summary: Burke pursues the escaped Veza and breaks her ankle, but the Otaria Trench is sealed and he is trapped with Laquatus's army.
events.quote: Burke relentlessly pursued her, but only succeeded in breaking her ankle

events.summary: Laquatus escapes his prison and Burke accompanies him to the surface and across Otaria in pursuit of the Mirari.
events.quote: He faithfully followed Laquatus across Otaria in pursuit of the Mirari

events.summary: Balthor destroys Burke with a suicide fire spell as Laquatus tries to seize the Mirari.
events.quote: he was destroyed by Balthor when Laquatus tried to seize the Mirari

events.summary: A small part of Burke remaining in Balthor's throat lets Laquatus control Balthor after Braids turns him into a zombie.
events.quote: a small part of Burke remaining in his throat enabled Laquatus to take control of Balthor

relations.quote: a nightmare - horror created by Chainer with the Mirari for Ambassador Laquatus
Burke always served as the ambassador's bodyguard

relations.note: Destroyed him with a suicide fire spell.
relations.quote: he was destroyed by Balthor when Laquatus tried to seize the Mirari
